Up to £10,000 towards the tuition fees

Royal Agricultural University GREAT Scholarships 2022 is a combined initiative of the British Council and the UK Government for postgraduate applicants. The scholarship is designed to attract some of the brightest postgraduate applicants from around the world to study at UK universities. The selected scholar will receive each scholarship is worth up to £10,000 towards the tuition fees.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Hold a passport from an eligible country
Have a background of extracurricular activities or noteworthy experience relating to the subject area
The selected scholar will receive each scholarship up to £10,000 towards the tuition fees.
A statement of purpose with information on the motivations and goals as well as relevant extracurricular activities and work experience should be provided
Eligible candidates can apply for the scholarship by following the steps mentioned below -
Apply for the specified course for which the scholarship is offered.
After receiving the offer from the university, apply for the scholarship by sending a statement of purpose through email at -
The scholarship is awarded on the basis of academic excellence and relevant experience.
Scholarship winners will be expected to undertake RAU international ambassador duties during their studies at the RAU and after graduation.
The award cannot be deferred to the next intake or year of study.
The decision of the RAU is final and there can be no appeal against an unsuccessful outcome.
Stroud Rd, Cirencester GL7 6JS, United Kingdom
